Definition: shut up, i.e. impeded (as to the use of the right hand)
BiblicalUsage: Shut up in the right hand is the phrase for a man who cannot use it, a left-handed man. In Judges 3:15 Ehud is a Benjamite, a man lefthanded, and the LORD raises him up to deliver Israel, and in Judges 20:16 there are seven hundred chosen men lefthanded, every one of whom can sling stones at an hair breadth and not miss.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the left hand is the point: God raises a deliverer from the hand nobody would choose, and seven hundred men who cannot miss with the other one.
RelatedEvents: Ehud and Eglon; The Levite's Concubine and the War against Benjamin
